description: Canonical approved brand assets bundled with the operational dashboard. Source libraries remain in vitra-agentes-marketing; this package contains only production-ready assets needed by the tool.
rules: Do not depend on absolute Windows paths for runtime brand assets.
Do not import experimental or test folders into this operational package.
Prefer SVG for UI/render composition and PNG 8K or png-6x for export previews and raster fallbacks.
Supabase Edge Functions may keep critical logo SVG inline; this package is the dashboard/public asset source.
